summary: This is an operational update filing on Form 6-K by Agnico Eagle Mines Limited reporting a rock mass movement (wall movement) at the Barnat open pit at its Canadian Malartic complex. The event caused no injuries or environmental damage but led to a temporary suspension of mining operations in that pit. The company expects a reduction in 2026 production of 60,000-80,000 ounces and up to ~150,000 ounces per year in 2027-2028. No transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic corporate event is involved; it is a routine operational incident disclosure.
